title: Core Edge Firewall HA Firmware Upgrade from 7.0.12 to 7.2.6
business_justification: Remediates critical CVE-2026-4428 zero-day authentication bypass vulnerability on edge perimeter.

risk_assessment.redundancy_notes: Active-passive stateful HA cluster with zero-loss session failover.
risk_assessment.precedent_notes: Upgraded secondary staging firewall successfully on Nov 10.

pre_checks.description: Capture active BGP neighbor sessions and routes count
Verify HA cluster synchronization status and checksums
Create offline system configuration backup to secure TFTP

implementation_steps.action: Upload firmware image to standby node02 and verify SHA-256 hash
Reboot standby node02 into 7.2.6 and monitor post-boot HA rejoin
Initiate graceful HA failover to transfer active traffic to node02
Upgrade node01 to 7.2.6 and confirm cluster re-synchronization

rollback_plan.trigger_conditions: Continuous ping packet loss > 5% for > 3 minutes, IPsec tunnels fail to renegotiate, or BGP route flapping detected on node02.

commands.action: Force cluster failback immediately to node01 running verified 7.0.12
Restore pre-change config from TFTP if state is inconsistent

verification_plan.description: Verify HA cluster state and full sync checksum match
Confirm all 24 branch IPsec VPN tunnels are established (Phase 2 UP)
Execute synthetic HTTP/HTTPS external connectivity tests from DMZ web cluster
